english.meaning: counts groups of people, especially tour groups
english.note: 唔成團 means not enough people signed up, so the tour is cancelled. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Then it turned out his group wasn’t happening.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉跟住點知原來佢話佢嗰團唔成團啊。
